About.title: About me
About.description: I build and maintain systems using Node.js, Vue.js, React, TypeScript, and Neo4j. I have a special interest in software architecture (I think it's really cool), data modeling, and API design, but I also really enjoy the visual and interactive side of front-end. In my free time, I'm probably studying some new technology or language, playing something, watching anime, or drinking coffee.
About.buttonText: Oh, and you can check out my resume here

Vexur.description: I work on the development, evolution, and maintenance of web solutions, building APIs and applications using Node.js, TypeScript, Neo4j, Vue.js, and React. My work involves data modeling, system integrations, developing new features, modernizing existing applications, and process automation, always prioritizing simple, scalable, and maintainable solutions. Below are my main contributions:

mainContribuitions.name: Integration with the Cooper Card payment institution
mainContribuitions.description: Designed and developed an integration for generating and managing commission payment files, implementing the API with Fastify, TypeScript, and Neo4j, and the interface with Vue 3, including export history tracking and traceability.

mainContribuitions.name: MedSenior Integration
mainContribuitions.description: Develop and maintain the integration responsible for the proposal onboarding process with health plan provider MedSenior, overseeing the end-to-end flow, from data submission and adaptation to response processing, digital signing, and proposal implementation. I also built an interface to track proposal status and progress.

mainContribuitions.name: MXM Integration
mainContribuitions.description: Maintain and evolve the integration with the MXM ERP, responsible for customer synchronization and submission of financial receivables. I developed automated processes for periodic customer registration and submission of receivables not yet integrated, plus an interface to monitor processed customers and receivables.

mainContribuitions.name: Email Communication System
mainContribuitions.description: Restructured the attachment generation flow by building a reusable solution that reduced code coupling and eliminated the need for manual changes for new communications.

mainContribuitions.name: Communication Viewer Migration
mainContribuitions.description: Led the modernization of the communication viewers, migrating from Vue 2 to React, improving the development experience and making the application easier to evolve and maintain.

mainContribuitions.name: Neo4j Query Optimization and Compatibility
mainContribuitions.description: Analyzed and refactored Cypher queries, reviewing the data model when needed to simplify searches, reduce query complexity, and improve application performance. Adapted Cypher queries and made the necessary adjustments to ensure compatibility with the new database version (4 to 5), contributing to the platform upgrade and application continuity.
